facts.text: SoFA District is home to the historic California Theater, where the annual Cinequest film festival premieres each spring.
Local business owners named the district SoFA after the San Jose Redevelopment Agency’s failed “Market Gateway” proposal.
In the late 1980s, councilwoman Susan Hammer led an initiative that removed adult businesses from SoFA, reshaping its nightlife.
Arts Place gave $500,000 in 2011 to fund a SoFA Initiative that turned Parque de los Pobladores into an outdoor living room.
SoFA hosts a calendar of festivals, including South First Fridays, the SoFA Street Fair, and the Zero1 Biennial.
The three blocks of South First Street grew organically into a nightlife hub with clubs, theaters, restaurants, galleries, and design firms.
